readme.run: Reconstruct susceptibility maps from a BIDS dataset
notes: QSMbly's command line is QSMxT 9.22.0, the native build of the qsm-core
pipeline the web app runs. Every QSMxT command works: use the command QSMbly
exports with qsmbly in place of qsmxt. Run qsmbly help for all commands, and
qsmbly dicom-convert DICOM_DIR BIDS_DIR to convert DICOM first.
Deep-learning weights are not included. A command that names a model
downloads it once from a pinned URL and checks its SHA-256. For a machine
without a network, run qsmbly download-models (1.7 GB) and copy
~/.cache/neurodesk/qsmbly/models, or set QSMBLY_OFFLINE=1 to forbid downloads.
QSMxT is research software. Please cite: Stewart AW, Robinson SD, O'Brien K,
et al. QSMxT: Robust masking and artifact reduction for quantitative
susceptibility mapping. Magnetic Resonance in Medicine. 2022;87(3):1289-1300.
